name: Master Prospector
summary: Once per long rest, declare a battlefield claim. Choose one 30-ft area you can see. For 1 minute, you and allies ignore difficult terrain in that area, gain +1 to attacks against enemies in it, and have advantage on checks to interact with machinery, cover, doors, terrain, salvage, or objectives inside it.
